text:
Elena Park: Heads-up: we're shipping a docs + SDK flag that tightens parameter normalization for generate/chat calls. This is to reduce surprising tokenization mismatches in downstream evals. See notes below.

Tom Wu: TL;DR: SDK will normalize `stop` and `temperature` shapes more strictly. v4.4 warns; v5 enforces. We'll provide a `legacy_param_mode` toggle.

Riley (Docs): I'll add a short banner and a migration snippet to quickstarts. Need the exact CLI/env var names.

Elena Park: Names: env RW_LEGACY_PARAMS=true or SDK config `{ legacy_param_mode: true }`. Default off in v5.

QA-Bot: Tests to add: assert old-style arrays for `stop` emit a warning when not in legacy mode.

InfraBot: Rolling to canary: release sdk/v4.4.0-rc1 -> us-east-1 canary. Metric: param_normalization_warnings.

Tom Wu: Action items: Tom -> RC and changelog. Riley -> docs banner + migration guide. QA -> test sweep and list failing integrations by EOD Friday.

Riley (Docs): Draft banner: "Note: SDK parameter normalization is changing. Enable legacy mode to suppress warnings. See migration guide (internal link)."

Elena Park: Thanks — please react with :eyes: when done reviewing the migration guide.

Tom Wu: :shipit:
